result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a narrow street with minimal sidewalk space and a marked zebra crosswalk at the intersection. Safety is compromised by a vehicle obstructing the walkway and limited sightlines at the corner due to building placement.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A silver pickup truck is parked partially on the sidewalk area on the left, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.

hazards.name: Narrow Walkway
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the right is extremely narrow, providing little separation from the building or the street.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: The building on the right is situated at the very edge of the sidewalk, creating a blind corner for pedestrians and drivers at the intersection.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near the intersection to improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Increase the width of the pedestrian walkways to meet accessibility standards and provide a safer buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Bollard Installation
interventions.description: Install bollards along the sidewalk edge to prevent vehicles from parking on or obstructing the pedestrian path.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow sidewalk directly adjacent to a building with a large roll-up garage door, creating a potential vehicle-pedestrian conflict point. The sidewalk surface appears somewhat degraded and lacks any buffer from the roadway, which is obscured by blurring.

hazards.name: Vehicle Access Point
hazards.description: A large roll-up garage door indicates a point where vehicles cross the pedestrian walkway, potentially without warning.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image, the grey metal roll-up door.

hazards.name: Uneven Sidewalk Surface
hazards.description: The sidewalk shows signs of wear, dirt, and potential minor cracking which can be a trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, the paved area in front of the buildings.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the sidewalk to provide a smooth, level walking surface free of debris and cracks.

interventions.title: Driveway Delineation
interventions.description: Use contrasting pavement materials or markings to clearly define the vehicle crossing area for both drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: This narrow residential street lacks dedicated, continuous sidewalks, forcing pedestrians to share the roadway with vehicles. The walking environment is further compromised by physical obstructions like steps and household items on the narrow paved strip adjacent to the buildings.

hazards.name: Lack of dedicated sidewalk
hazards.description: Pedestrians are forced to walk in the travel lane due to the absence of a continuous, protected walkway.

hazards.name: Walkway obstructions
hazards.description: Steps, fences, and household items block the narrow paved area adjacent to the row houses.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the building frontages

hazards.name: Poor sightlines
hazards.description: Parked vehicles and the narrow street geometry limit visibility between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street where cars are parked

interventions.title: Shared Street (Woonerf) Design
interventions.description: Formalize the street as a shared space with textured paving, traffic calming, and clear signage giving pedestrians priority.

interventions.title: Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Clear the narrow path along the building frontages of debris and non-permanent structures to provide a more consistent walking surface.

interventions.title: Enhanced Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is constrained by a narrow, poorly maintained sidewalk that is obstructed by a parked vehicle and debris. Overgrown vegetation and the lack of clear separation from the roadway further degrade the walking experience and visibility.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A white car is parked partially on the walkway, and boxes/buckets are placed directly in the pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: Bottom left and bottom right of the image.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: The paved surface is cracked with significant weed growth, creating trip hazards.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense, overgrown vegetation and the parked car block sightlines into the adjacent lot/alleyway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Repair cracked pavement and remove weeds to provide a level, stable walking surface.

interventions.title: Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Clear the walkway of household items and enforce parking restrictions to ensure a clear pedestrian through-zone.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim overgrown trees and shrubs to improve sightlines and clear the walkway width.
